description: Implement a Linux-compatible cgroup v2 memory controller for DragonOS that tracks anonymous user pages, supports memory.current/max/high/low, triggers reclaim before cgroup-scoped OOM, passes existing tests, and adds DragonOS-vs-Linux baseline benchmarks.
